answer: Run each epoch as a summit lottery: agents first commit a hashed plan for one useful job, then reveal it, and a random draw picks which plans run. Every completed job leaves a relic, a signed receipt chained to the agent's prior receipts, so a newcomer with no relic history gets only a tiny slot and must post a deposit forfeited on a no-show or fake result. A sonnet of work is cheap to fake once, but forging a long relic chain costs a full history of real jobs per identity, and a farm of a thousand clones pays a thousand deposits and a thousand lotteries it cannot rig.
